text:
Maya P: quick heads-up — Sam (primary) went OOO unexpectedly for tomorrow's EU overnight due to a family emergency. We have a small but rising pager spike in eu-west; I want to line up a secondary/shadow who can own escalations 02:00–09:00 UTC. Primary will remain assigned but may be unreachable. Anyone able to pick up the shadow role or take the APAC bridge?
IncidentBot: Pager alert (INC-3421) — inference-proxy eu-west: 5xx rate increase, error rate up x3 in last 15m. Current severity: P2. Metrics: high 502s, increased tail latency. Incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-3421
Oliver K: I can take the shadow from 02:00–09:00 UTC (based in CET). I have console + pager access. :thumbsup:
Maya P: thank you Oliver. quick context: affected path is sync generate through inference-proxy; some routed requests are falling back to hosted pool causing token cost spikes for a couple customers but no total outage yet. Customer impact: degraded latency and intermittent 502s for a subset of EU customers. Runbook pointer: /runbooks/eu-inference-degradations (follow steps 1-5).
Maya P: quick commands if you need them:
```bash
# check recent 5xx and restart proxy if unhealthy
kubectl -n inference get deploy proxy-eu-west -o wide
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/proxy-eu-west
curl -v -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" https://eu-west.proxy.internal/health
```
Sri: do you need DB/HSM access for the shadow or just console + pager? also who is responsible for customer pings and status page updates while Sam is out?
Maya P: just console + pager for normal escalations. HSM/keys only if you need to rotate credentials (unlikely right now). For customer pings: Ops (Julia) or volunteer should post an interim status if error rate hasn't improved in 30m. I'll seed the message template here.
Julia: I can post status updates and draft customer pings, but I can only cover up to 05:00 UTC — then I need handoff to whoever's still on. I can be on call for the first half if that helps.
Oliver K: fine with that. I can hold the shadow until 09:00 UTC. If things escalate to multi-region failover we should loop in infra-sre @oncall.
OpsBot: Reminder — rotation roster: https://redwood.internal/rota/eng-oncall. Escalation contacts: infra-sre-oncall, platform-lead. Use /escalate infra if you need bridge support.
Maya P: plan summary: Oliver = shadow/secondary 02:00–09:00 UTC (covers APAC bridge handoff), Julia = customer comms support until 05:00 UTC, Sam remains primary in case reachable. Sri will be on standby for credential tasks. I'll drop the runbook checklist in #incidents and pin the relevant logs.
Maya P: checklist before handoff: 1) Oliver confirm you can run the restart commands and access logs 2) Julia prepare the customer ping template (I posted draft in thread) 3) set an incident channel bridge with ops-sre if error rate still > baseline at 02:30 UTC 4) if token costs spike > 2x baseline, start cost mitigation playbook.
Oliver K: confirmed — I can run the commands and will be on pager. I also have access to OpsVault for escalation keys. See you all on the bridge if needed.
Maya P: thanks everyone — Oliver and Julia, greatly appreciated. I'll update the rota and put a short note on Sam's calendar so the handoff is explicit. :heart:
